PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-001.text: Token comparison in auth middleware must use constant-time algorithm to prevent timing attacks.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-001.assertion: forall req: auth_check(req.token, API_AUTH_TOKEN) uses timing_safe_equal()

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-001.text: All non-health endpoints must reject requests without valid Bearer token with 401 or 403.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-001.assertion: forall req where path != '/health': !valid_token(req) => response.status in {401, 403}

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-002.text: No RBAC: any authenticated caller can invoke role assignment, nickname update, and member enumeration.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-002.assertion: forall endpoint in protected_routes: auth_pass(req) => endpoint.accessible(req) == true

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-002.text: Nickname update must sanitize user-supplied name to prevent Discord formatting injection.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-002.assertion: forall req to /api/nickname/update: sanitized(req.body.name) before discord.setNickname()

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-003.text: discord_uid parameter must be validated as a numeric Discord snowflake before use in DB queries.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-003.assertion: forall req with discord_uid: matches(req.discord_uid, /^\d{17,20}$/) before db_query()

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-004.text: Generation parameter must be validated as a positive integer with upper bound before role creation.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-003.text: Production error responses must not expose internal error details, stack traces, or database info.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-003.assertion: forall err where NODE_ENV=='production': response.body excludes stack_trace AND db_details

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-004.text: CORS must not default to wildcard origin; ALLOWED_ORIGINS must be explicitly configured.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-004.assertion: cors_config.origin != '*' && env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS is defined and non-empty

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-005.text: Supabase client must use service_role key only; fallback to anon key must not occur.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-005.text: Role sync endpoint must validate discord_uid exists in DB before making Discord API calls.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-005.assertion: forall sync(uid): db.members.exists(uid) == true before discord.addRole() called

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-006.text: Role sync must be idempotent: executing twice with same DB state produces same Discord role set.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-006.assertion: forall uid: sync(uid); sync(uid) => discord_roles(uid) == discord_roles_after_first_sync(uid)

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-007.text: Role sync must only add/remove roles managed by the bot; must not modify unrelated Discord roles.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-008.text: Leader role must be assigned iff member exists in team_leaders table.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-009.text: Team leader can exist without being a team member due to missing FK constraint to member_team_relations.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-009.assertion: NOT enforced: forall (tid,mid) in team_leaders: (mid,tid) in member_team_relations

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-006.text: Discord API calls in role sync must handle rate limit responses (429) with retry/backoff.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-010.text: API endpoints must enforce rate limiting to prevent Discord API rate limit exhaustion via amplification.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-007.text: Name parameter length must be bounded before passing to Discord nickname setter.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-011.text: Nickname format for active members must be 'name(student_id)' matching DB record.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-011.assertion: forall update(uid, name) where status in {0,1}: nickname == name + '(' + student_number + ')'

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-012.text: Nickname format for alumni must be 'name(N期卒業生)' where N is generation number.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-012.assertion: forall update(uid, name) where status==2: nickname == name + '(' + generation + '期卒業生)'

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-013.text: Generation role creation and DB insert are non-atomic; Discord role orphan possible on DB failure.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-014.text: Generation value must be unique in generation_roles table; duplicate creation returns 409.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-017.text: Soft-deleted members (deleted_at != NULL) must not receive role sync or nickname updates.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-017.assertion: forall op in {sync, nickname_update}: member.deleted_at != NULL => op returns 404

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-019.text: Member status transitions must follow valid progression: 0→1→2; invalid transitions must be rejected.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-019.assertion: forall update(uid, new_status): new_status == current_status + 1 || reject

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-020.text: MEMBER role assigned only to status 0 or 1; status 2 members must not have MEMBER role after sync.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-021.text: VERIFIED role must be assigned to all DB-registered members regardless of status after sync.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-021.assertion: forall sync(uid) where member.exists(uid): has_role(uid, VERIFIED_ROLE_ID) == true

PROP-stem-bot-v2-asm-001.text: API_AUTH_TOKEN must be loaded from environment and must not be hardcoded or empty.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-asm-002.text: Server must reject startup if critical env vars (API_AUTH_TOKEN, SUPABASE_URL, DISCORD_TOKEN) are missing.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-asm-003.text: All Supabase queries must use parameterized queries; no string concatenation with user input.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-asm-003.assertion: forall db_query(user_input): query uses parameterized binding, not string interpolation

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-008.text: Member enumeration endpoint must not expose sensitive fields (student_number, supabase_auth_user_id).
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-008.assertion: forall resp from /api/members: resp.body excludes {student_number, supabase_auth_user_id}

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-022.text: Auth middleware must not skip token validation for any path except /health.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-022.assertion: forall req where path != '/health': auth_middleware.executed(req) == true

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-023.text: Role sync DB query must filter out soft-deleted members (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-023.assertion: forall sync(uid): db_query includes WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-024.text: Teams table allows duplicate names and duplicate discord_role_ids; sync must handle ambiguity.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-024.assertion: role_sync handles teams WHERE discord_role_id has duplicates without assigning wrong roles

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-009.text: Discord API errors during role sync must not leave member in partially synced state without error response.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-009.assertion: forall sync(uid): discord_api_error => response indicates partial failure with details

PROP-stem-bot-v2-post-001.text: After role sync, member's Discord roles must match exactly the set derived from DB state.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-post-002.text: After generation role creation, generation_roles entry must correspond to existing Discord role.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-025.text: is_admin field defaults to FALSE; explicit grant required to set TRUE.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-025.assertion: forall INSERT into members: is_admin == FALSE unless explicitly set

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-010.text: Request body size must be bounded to prevent large payload DoS on all POST endpoints.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-inv-027.text: Bearer token must not be logged in any request/error log output.

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-011.text: Auth middleware must reject tokens that do not exactly match; partial prefix match must fail.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-011.assertion: forall token: auth_pass(token) <=> token == API_AUTH_TOKEN (exact, full-length match)

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-012.text: Unhandled exceptions must not crash the Express process; global error handler must catch all.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-012.assertion: forall unhandled_error: error_handler catches && returns 500 && process continues

PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-013.text: Malformed JSON body must be rejected with 400, not cause unhandled parse exception.
PROP-stem-bot-v2-pre-013.assertion: forall POST req with invalid JSON: response.status == 400 && no process crash

PROP-api-request-asm-001.text: Bearer token comparison must use timing-safe equality to prevent side-channel leakage.

PROP-api-request-inv-001.text: All /api/ routes except health check must reject requests without valid Bearer token.
PROP-api-request-inv-001.assertion: forall req to /api/*: req.path != '/health' => req.headers.authorization == 'Bearer ' + API_AUTH_TOKEN

PROP-api-request-inv-002.text: No RBAC: role assign/remove endpoints allow any authenticated caller to grant arbitrary Discord roles.
PROP-api-request-inv-002.assertion: forall caller, role: authenticated(caller) => canAssignRole(caller, role) -- no privilege differentiation

PROP-api-request-pre-001.text: discord_uid parameter must be validated as non-empty string before any database or Discord API call.
PROP-api-request-pre-001.assertion: forall endpoint(req): uses_discord_uid(req) => typeof req.discord_uid == 'string' && req.discord_uid.length > 0

PROP-api-request-pre-002.text: discord_role_id must be validated as non-empty string before role assign/remove operations.

PROP-api-request-inv-003.text: Nickname update input must be sanitized to prevent injection of control characters or excessive length.

PROP-api-request-inv-004.text: Role assignment must not allow granting roles higher than bot's highest role in Discord hierarchy.

PROP-api-request-inv-005.text: CORS must not default to wildcard (*) when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset — must fail closed.

PROP-api-request-inv-006.text: Supabase client must never fall back from service_role key to anon key silently.
PROP-api-request-inv-006.assertion: supabase.init() => key == SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || throw Error('missing service_role key')
